# pve_sdn_lock_release (Action)

Release (or force-release) the global SDN configuration lock.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_sdn_lock_release" "example" {
  config {
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_sdn_lock_release.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `force` (Boolean) if true, allow releasing lock without providing the token (default: 0)
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
